messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial.
The trial was in adults with type 2 diabetes.
The adults had blood sugar that was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone.
Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%.
This is compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg.
The average HbA1c change was -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834)", "duration", "40 weeks"]

The relation 'duration' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject clinical trial lasted for the specified length of time.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
B. 'has half life': The subject drug has a specific duration of time for its half-life, as specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effect duration': The subject drug's effect lasts for a duration that is relative to the object entity.
D. 'has clinical trial result': The subject drug has demonstrated or shown the clinical trial outcome specified by the object entity.
E. 'has duration in system': The subject drug remains in the body for the time period specified by the object entity after the last dose.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
